scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 22 replaces the bundled-model architecture with an update-safe user-owned 3D Models library and fixes the browser cursor regression found during user testing. Settings > Customization is the only location for Platform visuals: Icons or 3D Models, Icon card size, 3D model size, and Open 3D Models Folder. PlatformVisualStyle and both scale settings persist across restarts. Huymaier Console automatically creates %LOCALAPPDATA%\Huymaier Console\3D Models with a README listing the exact 36 original Huymaier model-pack filenames and also recognizes a portable 3D Models folder beside HuymaierConsole.ps1. Games cards start from the normal icon card; when 3D Models is selected and a matching user GLB exists the final runtime replaces the icon host with real live x64 WPF Viewport3D geometry. Missing GLBs retain the normal icon and never substitute a static atlas render. Customization displays the detected GLB count. X/Square on a mapped platform card opens the live rotatable/zoomable model viewer while A/Cross continues to open the platform. Normal release bytes contain zero bundled GLBs; the staged gate instead creates a temporary GLB and proves the packaged HuymaierLiveModel3D.dll can load, rotate, zoom and rescale real geometry. Web browser cursor ownership is native-only: the retired Optimize-ControllerBrowserCursor.ps1 transform is not invoked, HuymaierWebBrowser.ps1 does not receive hc-virtual-cursor DOM code, and HuymaierUnifiedCursor.ps1 is loaded after WebBrowser and Customization so the native system cursor owns browser input last. Preserve every prior v0.26.5 GameCube, downloads, native streaming, Sony Raw-HID, Game Bar, Wii/Dolphin, provider concurrency, installer rollback/tamper, Steam/Nintendo ownership, performance and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 gate. Upload only if all source and staged user-model, persistence, scale, Customization-only, no-bundled-GLB, native-cursor-final-ownership, legacy-DOM-cursor-retired and inherited regression gates succeed together.
